newsitem.title: USA: Trans World Gaming restates Q2, $0.20 loss.
newsitem.headline: Trans World Gaming restates Q2, $0.20 loss.

text.p: Trans World Gaming Corp said Wednesday that it restated its second quarter results are a $0.20 per share loss on net losses of $510,000.
The company previously reported second quarter losses of $0.03 per share on net losses of $87,000.
The company said restated results show interest expense in the second quarter was adjusted by $416,000, up to $581,000.
As a result, the company said, its net loss for the six months ended June 30, 1996 is $679,000, or $0.27 per share.
The company said it previously reported a loss of $256,046, or $0.10 per share for the six months ended June 30, 1996.
